item.description:
# Draftava 1.3.10
- Fixes Move from the Idea Shelf into a draft, including card-content and handle dragging. - Preserves Copy behavior and undo/redo. - Corrects padding around Notes in the Idea Shelf editor. - Removes the previous activation-code screen and license requirement.
Lemon Squeezy licensing is planned separately.
Existing project files, iCloud safeguards, and Sparkle updates remain supported.
